intro: Lesson 29. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ (٣١) وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ (٣٢) ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ (٣٣) أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ (٣٤) ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ (٣٥) أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى (٣٦) أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ (٣٧) ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ (٣٨) فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ (٣٩) أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ (٤٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed. But [instead], he denied and turned away.
And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride]. Woe to you, and woe!
Then woe to you, and woe! Does man think that he will be left neglected?
Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted? Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
And made of him two mates, the male and the female. Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Qiyamah 75:31-40 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 75:31-40 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 75:31-40 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite all of Al-Qiyamah 75:1 to 40 to a partner.

questions.a: The One who created a person in stages from a small beginning can certainly gather his bones again.

questions.q: 75:40 asks: is not that Creator able to ...
questions.a: A) give life to the dead. 75:40: 'Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?'

questions.q: Think again: 'Does man think that he will be left neglected?' (75:36). Why is it important to know that life has a purpose?
questions.a: Because Allah created us for a reason, our choices matter; He who created us can bring us back (75:40).
